subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently replace the standalone Talk destination with Chat as the single text-and-voice surface, while retaining `talk` and `voice` launch aliases as compatibility routes into Chat?
rationale: The patch is technically well-proven, but removing a shipped destination and redefining its launch aliases is a product and upgrade-contract choice that repository policy does not allow automation to settle.

options.title: Sponsor Unified Chat
options.body: Approve Chat as the sole conversational destination, retain the aliases as compatibility routes, and require the unrelated localization drift to be removed before merge.

options.title: Preserve Standalone Talk
options.body: Keep Talk as a destination and narrow this work to shared composer controls, session ownership, and Live Activity improvements without changing navigation ownership.

options.title: Defer The Redesign
options.body: Keep the existing Chat/Talk model and close or substantially narrow this PR until the iOS roadmap explicitly sponsors the unified destination.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Unified Chat
recommendation.body: Approve Chat as the sole conversational destination, retain the aliases as compatibility routes, and require the unrelated localization drift to be removed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership guidance and the existing review routing most directly connect this person to iOS Talk behavior and the permanent product decision.
